claim: Test whether full-window next-byte supervision, rather than missing context alone, causes the tiny dialogue mouth to optimize low teacher-forced CE while collapsing in prompt-conditioned generation.

views.probe: first eight SHA-ordered single-exchange training documents

model.schedule: 50-step linear warmup then cosine to 0.1 peak ratio

arms.O0_full: existing ce_marginal over every target byte
arms.O1_additive: existing ce_marginal plus answer_ce weight 1.0 over every canonical assistant span
arms.O2_response_only: answer_ce weight 1.0 over every canonical assistant span; full-window ce_marginal is monitor-only and contributes no gradient

gates.single_document_positive_control: all three arms exactly reproduce the registered assistant response
gates.heldout_full_ce_descent: O2 final held-out full CE is below uniform CE and below its first registered held-out full CE
gates.prompt_conditioning: O2 produces at least 6/8 non-empty replies and at least six normalized distinct replies
gates.target_recovery: O2 shares the first 16 UTF-8 target bytes on at least 6/8 probes
gates.structural: O2 passes all 8 existing structural checks
gates.control_honesty: O0/O1 results are reported losslessly but cannot promote O2

promotion.303m_single_seed: allowed only if every O2 gate passes; requires a separate preregistration

failure_policy.if_local_or_data_gate_fails: record failure and do not rent a GPU
failure_policy.if_O2_fails: record and preserve raw evidence; do not run 303M or couple IIT state
